comment: Amazing teacher, super willing to help and very in-depth lectures. Felt a little lost at some points, but he was always available to cover topics in office hours. Tests were extremely difficult and require a lot of effort in preparation, but you learn a lot. Definitely worth it and would take it again.

Took him for Fin360. One of the best in the b-school. He values hard work and is very clear about his expectations. Learn the concepts, practice with the questions he provides, and get to know him outside of class. An incredible resource beyond just class!

He is the business school hottie and, on top of that, an incredible instructor. His class was super insightful—exams are tough, but his detailed notes and crystal-clear lectures make a huge difference. He's also a big advocate for students' careers and genuinely goes above and beyond to help you succeed.

Farizo is the man. Easily the best teacher I have ever had. Expectations are crystal clear, easy to talk to, material is clearly presented. Difficult class, but by no means impossible at all. Cannot recommend Farizo enough!

While taking investments with Joe, I didn't really enjoy the class too much. It is very lecture heavy and he seemed overly rehearsed. But then after a while I began to understand why he was that way. He cares more about the class and students than any other teacher I've had and so for that reason he really is a great teacher. Totally recommend.

By far one of the best professors in the finance department. Makes you work for your grade and all questions from tests and assignments appear in his lectures. Organized schedule and graded on many things. Fair and you always know what you need to do to get an A. Always accessible outside class if needed and took feedback seriously.

Professor Farizo has been by far my favorite professor at UR. He was so nice and made sure that every single lecture had material that was relevant to something going on in the current markets. Such a nice guy that had great organization

One of my favorite professors so far at UR. Has very straightforward lectures and gives access to all powerpoints and excel files for practice. Very well organized and gives fair assignments and tests. Always asks for feedback and cares how students think he can improve. Keep in mind he gives 0s for all late homework though.
